description: A hearth fire crackling: a loop played at the hearth (3D, mono). Its pops are limited so the fire's body reaches ambience loudness.
prompt: A clean close recording of a wood fire burning in a stone hearth, {variation}, natural and quiet, no background noise, no hiss, no hum, no music, no voices.
variations: soft natural crackling of dry logs
gentle flames with occasional small pops
a steady fire with logs settling
feedback: 2026-11-28 owner: distortion and noise in the background of the second series; prompts now ask for a clean, natural recording
